name: Esufey Retreat
body:
You call upon your elemental affinity to steal you away to safety.

Prerequisite(s): Esufey Might, character level 11th, esufey.

Benefit: Once per day as a full-round action, you can move into an extradimensional space, as maze except that you can remain there for 1 hour and can leave at any time as a free action, returning to your original location. You cannot take anyone else with you, and you must leave the extradimensional space before you can use teleportation abilities such as dimension door or plane shift.
